title: SPRINGFIELD SYMPHONY: Ravel – A Theatrical Concert
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: Ravel – A Theatrical Concert
description: Springfield Symphony: Ravel – A Theatrical Concert is a performance for actors, singers, and orchestra, created by Alice Wiley Pickett, that portrays composer Maurice Ravel alongside Claude Debussy and George Gershwin. Drawing on Ravel's own writings, the words of his friends and harshest critics, and his music, it offers a comic and poignant, impressionistic picture of the composer. It takes place Saturday, January 16, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
